synopsis: A boy who was kidnapped by a Tengu and taken to a fairyland. He speaks of an unbelievable world, and those who aspire to it will strive to reach the pinnacle of martial arts. A great fantasy tale from Kazuhiro Fujita! (Source: Sunday Webry, translated)
